name: aura-monorepo
description: aura — a simple-surface, deep-core astrology app on a real Vedic engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,vim -c blue,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:vim"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,vim,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:vim" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/engine && npm run test --workspace packages/knowledge && npm run test --workspace apps/vim && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace apps/api
scripts.check:generated: npm run check --workspace @vim/tokens && npm run check --workspace @vim/vectors
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/knowledge && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/vim && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace apps/api
